Downloaded: 2026-10-24.

XingyuConnect installs this separate Android package only when its IME service is absent.
An existing installed ADBKeyboard is reused, not automatically replaced.
Text uses ADB_INPUT_B64 and UTF-8 Base64. Keys use ADB_INPUT_CODE,
or the upstream ADB_INPUT_TEXT mcode format for modifier keys.
Broadcasts explicitly target com.android.adbkeyboard.
No upstream APK or Java source modifications were made.
